seoExperiments.title: SEO experiments
seoExperiments.intro: When you change titles, tags or photos, KolayXport compares views and orders 14 days before and after, against your listings that did not change.
seoExperiments.empty: No experiments yet. Change a title, tags or photos on an active listing and the result appears here about 15 days later.

statusHelp.low_traffic: Fewer than 30 views in the 14 days before the change, so the result may not be reliable. Still measuring — result on {date}.
statusHelp.insufficient_data: Too few views or orders to say anything reliable.
statusHelp.confounded: Another change to the same listing happened during the measurement, so the effect can't be separated.

control.category: Compared with your listings in the same category
control.none: No comparison listings — treat with caution

metrics.rankDelta: {count, plural, one {# keyword} other {# keywords}} · average {delta, number} places

seoExperiments.seasonal: Holiday season: Nov 15 – Jan 5 traffic swings can distort this result.
